description: The chart illustrates estimated “effect” values for four morphosyntactic tag categories (case, gender, number, tense) across six model/setting combinations shown in the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable labeled “tag,” with categories ordered left to right as case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and a bit above 20), and each bar includes a vertical error bar indicating uncertainty around the bar height. For each tag category, six adjacent bars are grouped together (not stacked), corresponding to the legend entries: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (darker blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (darker green), mBERT-B₂ (light red/pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). In the case group, the two blue bars are around 6 and ~5.5, the two green bars are around ~3 and ~2, and the two red bars are the tallest in the figure at roughly ~12 and ~11, each with large error bars extending to around the low 20s. In the gender group, the blue bars are near ~1.5 and ~0.5, the green bars are around ~1.8 and ~1.0, and the red bars are around ~4 and ~3.5, with moderate-to-large error bars. In the number group, the blue bars are around ~1.2 and ~0.8, the green bars are around ~0.9 and ~0.5, and the red bars are around ~2.8 and ~2.4, again with visible error bars. In the tense group, all bars are close to zero (roughly between about −0.5 and ~0.8), with small-to-moderate error bars; the red bars are slightly above zero while several blue/green bars sit near zero or slightly below. The bars within each group appear in a consistent legend order rather than being sorted by height, and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and the presence of error bars.
